audit: A - training-label maturity / temporal leakage in the PHOENIX-001 walk-forward

code_audited.track: experiments/phoenix/hypotheses/track/run_track.py oof_scores lines 128-162 (train filter: quarter<=test_start-1 and y.notna())

definitions.origin_q: a prediction is made for origin quarter q
definitions.decision_time: end of quarter q (end_time); features at q may include events whose available_at + injected lag falls inside q
definitions.label_window: (q, q+HORIZON] on the event clock, HORIZON=4
definitions.test_decision_time_primary: end of the fold's FIRST test origin quarter (earliest prediction made with that training set)
definitions.fit_time_stricter: end of the fold's last training quarter (the instant the training set is frozen); reported as a stricter variant
definitions.required_purge_quarters: number of trailing training origin quarters with label_observable_at > decision_time
definitions.leakage_channel: training rows whose label window (q,q+4] contains at least one quarter inside the fold's test period

assumptions: The harness decision convention is end-of-quarter q (stated in add_history_features docstring, phoenix_common.py lines 359-363); the audit uses that convention for both features and decisions.

available_at == event_date for every row in this database (frozen protocol 0.3) so L is a DECLARED publication delay, not a measured one; L=0 means the event is public the day it happens, which is optimistic.
Training rows are exactly the rows the v1 drivers used: quarter inside the train range and y not NaN (run_track.py:133, run_cell.py:52).
Purging is done at whole-quarter granularity (drop the offending origin quarters entirely); no fractional-quarter embargo is considered.
Fold test_decision_time is the earliest test decision of the fold; a single model is fitted per fold in v1, so that is the binding deadline.
The cell-level panel is rebuilt in memory from the frozen harness (no files written) and cross-checked against the archived v1 run log row counts.
The purged H8 re-run uses the identical v1 features, model, folds and seed; only the training-row mask changes.
Dependence between overlapping test label windows is not leakage and is reported separately.
not_testable_here: The true FDA publication delay of each event: the database stores available_at == event_date, so no real lag can be measured; L is declared.
Whether a real analyst would have had the labelled data at the decision instant: only the arithmetic assertion is testable.

Whether the same defect exists for the cell-level MODEL RESULT at a different magnitude: the cell-level walk-forward was not re-run (structure and row counts are audited; the defect is identical by construction).

panel_maturity.note: current cell_common.build_cell_panel builds the frame out to origin_end+4 before add_forward_target, so the right-truncation defect is FIXED at cell level; the 62,732 figure in evidence/01_build_panel.log is the pre-fix / frozen-smoke number

second_maturity_problem_cached_v1_track_.label_rule_at_last_origin: growth target needs the 8Q trailing mean (NaN for the first 7 observed quarters of every track) and the 4Q forward window (NaN after 2024Q2 because the v1 track panel was trimmed to ORIGIN_END=2025Q2 before add_forward_target was called; pc.build_joint_panel lines 336-339)

h8_rerun.panel: track_panel_L090.pkl + entrants_hhi_L090.csv (v1 cache), same features/model/folds/seed as run_track.py
